technical.summary: Mixed technicals with long-term trend support (EMA/SMA 50/200 bullish) but weak intermediate momentum, price below key moving averages, negative CMF, and bearish MACD histogram limit swing entry probability.

fundamental.summary: ACN shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 6 days present elevated volatility risk with no fundamental support.

sentiment.summary: Mixed congressional activity (1 small buy vs 2 small-to-medium sells) with no composite signal; market fear (40 VIX equivalent) presents contrarian opportunity but lack of news data and weak congressional conviction limit conviction.

risk.summary: Crisis VIX (421.4), flat yield curve, rising dollar, CPI event just passed, and earnings in 6 days create a highly adverse macro backdrop with extreme binary event risk for ACN.

debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term EMA/SMA 50/200 bullish alignment and price near support (286.32) offer contrarian entry in fear-driven market (VIX crisis), with potential mean reversion if macro stabilizes.
debate.key_bear_argument: Earnings in 6 days create binary event risk during crisis VIX; price below all intermediate moving averages, negative CMF, bearish MACD histogram, and zero fundamental/insider conviction eliminate swing trade probability.

decision.entry_rationale: Long-term EMA/SMA 50/200 bullish structure and price near support (286.32) offer contrarian appeal in fear-driven market. However, earnings binary event in 6 days and zero fundamental conviction eliminate swing trade viability.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings announcement in 6 days during crisis VIX (421.4) creates uncontrollable binary event risk; price below all intermediate moving averages and negative CMF indicate weak intermediate momentum.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case
decision.portfolio_note: Existing ACN position plus 2 other IT holdings in 22-position portfolio creates sector concentration; earnings proximity and high volatility warrant avoidance despite long-term technicals.
